slides.headline: DoT Blocked 129 Betting Sites on Orders High Courts Disown

slides.stat_label: Betting Sites Blocked in Two DoT Directions
bullets: 21 Jul: 34 sites, on a 'Rajasthan HC' order
2 Sep: 95 sites, on an 'Allahabad HC' order
Reuters: both still on DoT's website on 11 Nov
slides.credit_line: Sources: Reuters, Bar & Bench, The Wire

slides.stat_label: Court Records Matching Either 'Order', Reuters Found
bullets: Rajasthan HC registrar: order 'appears to be fraudulent'
Allahabad HC found its 'order' was never passed
Allahabad 'order' QR code opened an unrelated web page
slides.credit_line: Sources: Reuters, Bar & Bench, The Wire

slides.stat_label: Allahabad HC Complaint; UP Police Register a Case
bullets: Case against unknown persons: alleged forgery and cheating
No arrests reported; who made the orders unknown
DoT did not respond to Reuters' questions
